subject: Pack ABI-24 harness bind
body:
B harness bind (follow-up). Not PACK_ABI_24_24_PASS. XSim != board. PROGRAM=NO.

Compare contract:
1. Host: python verification/pack_abi24/pack_abi24_gold.py --compare DUT.jsonl
   DUT.jsonl rows: case_id, outcome, reason, ack, reject, generation_flipped, header_bytes
   R-04/G-04 also query_status, query_reason. Never status 0x00 or UNKNOWN.
2. XSim: verification/pack_abi24/tb_pack_abi24_xsim_compare.sv
   include pack_abi24_constants.svh + pack_abi24_expect.svh
   streams out/<CASE_ID>.mem
   Open TB has s_ready=0 (fail-closed). Bind pack_loader to s_valid/s_ready/s_data and load_ack/load_reject/reason_code/active_generation.
3. 24/24 XSim is PACK_ABI24_XSIM_PASS only. Ladder PACK_ABI_24_24_PASS is post-PROGRAM.
4. Do not import pack_abi24_gold.py or pack_vectors.py as the DUT encoder.
5. PA24-V-03 region_count=2 is gold. Shrinking gold to region_count==1 is forbidden.
